I wasn’t sure it would get a lot of use, but wow, I was wrong. If you have a kid that loves to take care of their stuffed animals and dolls, they might also love this. Prior to this purchase, I thought a box with some blankets would have the same effect. Nope. This looks like the real deal, and kids notice.Every night, the baby doll gets tucked in and rocked. It’s significantly expanded the care-taking and emotional development play options.Assembly was fast and easy. The few cosmetic imperfections in the paint were not significant or noticeable once assembled. It looks really cute. I would like more pattern/color options for the sleeping mat. Perhaps there is a way to order that separately?It fits Bitty Baby American Girl dolls, is MUCH less expensive than the Bitty Baby crib, and this wooden cradle can be gently rocked. Solid product. Good value for money.

La recomiendo !

features: White wooden rocking play cradle for dolls and stuffed animals up to 20 inches tall
Features smooth rocking motion and wipe-clean surface; includes cozy removable mattress

Coordinates perfectly with Mine to Love Play Bed, Play Bunk Bed, Play Armoire, Play Stroller, and Play High Chair; ships in its own special e-commerce packaging intended to be easier to open and reduce waste
Encourages empathy and helps kids express themselves
Makes a great gift for preschoolers, ages 3 to 5, for hands-on, screen-free play
